description: This file defines a utility object 'TvDeviceChecks' that contains a method to determine if the current device supports Android TV (Leanback) by checking the system feature.

classes.name: TvDeviceChecks
classes.description: An object providing utility methods for checking device support for Android TV features.

methods.name: isTv
methods.description: Checks if the device has the 'android.software.leanback' system feature indicating support for Android TV.
